args.title: Make BOM option true by default for CSV exports
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Ensure the 'bom' option in CsvOptions is true by default, which adds a byte order mark (BOM) at the start of CSV export files. This helps spreadsheet applications detect UTF-8 encoding correctly.

label: feature
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/export/csv.ts is involved because it sets the 'bom' option to true by default for CSV exports, adding a byte order mark (BOM) to assist spreadsheet applications in recognizing UTF-8 encoding.
